# Team Comms

Principles: lead with the conclusion, quantify, name owners and dates, flag risks early, no jargon for non-engineers.

## Weekly status (to manager/stakeholders)
```
Overall: 🟢/🟡/🔴 - one line why
Done this week: 3-5 outcome bullets (not tasks)
Next week: 3-5 bullets
Risks/blockers: risk - impact - mitigation - help needed from whom
Decisions made: link ADRs
```
Save as docs/status/YYYY-MM-DD.md if asked.

## Escalation
Problem (1 line) -> impact if unresolved (date/customer/cost) -> options with recommendation -> what decision/help you need and by when.

## Sprint plan
Sprint goal (1 sentence), committed items with owners, stretch items, capacity (incl. ~15-20% debt, on-call), known risks.

## Audience switch
Same facts, three versions on request: exec (3 lines), manager (status format), engineers (technical detail).
